TUTO_CAPTION_1_1:
"Mobile Suit Gundam Extreme VS. 2 Infinite Boost" is a C4"2-on-2
versus action game"Cr. The team that defeats more enemies faster wins.
TUTO_CAPTION_1_2: Learn the basic controls and enjoy the game.
TUTO_CAPTION_1_3:
Tilt the C4"Lever"Cr or C4"Left Stick"Cr (or the C4"D-pad"Cr) and
your unit will C4"move"Cr in that direction.
TUTO_CAPTION_2_1:
Press the C4"Jump button"Cr to make your unit C4"jump"Cr.
Hold it down longer to rise higher.
TUTO_CAPTION_L_2_1:
Press the C4"A button"Cr to make your unit C4"jump"Cr.
Hold it down longer to rise higher.
TUTO_CAPTION_2_2: Quickly press the C4"Jump button"Cr twice to perform a C4"Boost Dash"Cr.
TUTO_CAPTION_L_2_2: Press the C4"LT button"Cr to perform a C4"Boost Dash"Cr.
TUTO_CAPTION_2_3: C4"Jumps"Cr and C4"Boost Dashes"Cr use up the C4"Boost Gauge"Cr at the bottom of the screen.
TUTO_CAPTION_2_4:
When the Boost Gauge runs out, you enter C4"Overheat"Cr status.
During C4"Overheat"Cr, jumping, Boost Dashing, etc. are restricted.
TUTO_CAPTION_2_5: The C4"Boost Gauge"Cr recovers when your unit lands.
TUTO_CAPTION_2_6:
The Boost Dash is the basic movement action.
Let's practice Boost Dashing.
TUTO_CAPTION_3_1: A C4"Lock-On Marker"Cr is shown on the enemy you are targeting.
TUTO_CAPTION_3_2:
There are 3 kinds of C4"Lock-On Marker"Cr: red (in range), green (out of range),
and yellow (downed).
TUTO_CAPTION_3_3:
Attacks home in on enemies with a C1"red marker"Cr, so they hit easily.
Attacks don't home in on enemies with a C2"green marker"Cr, so they hit less.
TUTO_CAPTION_3_4: Attacks cannot hit enemies with a C4"yellow marker"Cr.
TUTO_CAPTION_3_5: Press the C4"Target Switch button"Cr to change the enemy you are targeting.
TUTO_CAPTION_L_3_5: Press the C4"LB button"Cr to change the enemy you are targeting.

TUTO_CAPTION_7_1:

to perform consecutive shooting actions.

To rapid-fire C4"shots"Cr, perform a C4"Cancel"Cr
using a C4"Boost Dash"Cr.

Repeat C4"ShootCr -> C4Boost DashCr -> C4ShootCr -> C4Boost Dash"Cr and so on
to C4"rapid-fire"Cr your C4"shots"Cr.

This rapid fire is a basic technique.

TUTO_CAPTION_L_9_1: Press the C4"Y button"Cr to perform a C4"Melee attack"Cr.

With a C1"red marker"Cr, pressing the C4"Melee button"Cr moves you toward it automatically.

With a C2"green marker"Cr, pressing the C4"Y button"Cr won't move you toward the enemy.
With a C1"red marker"Cr, pressing the C4"Y button"Cr moves you toward it automatically.
TUTO_CAPTION_9_3:
Press the C4"Melee button"Cr again while a C4"Melee attack"Cr is hitting
to easily perform a C4"combo attack"Cr.
TUTO_CAPTION_L_9_3:
Press the C4"Y button"Cr again while a C4"Melee attack"Cr is hitting
to easily perform a C4"combo attack"Cr.
TUTO_CAPTION_9_4:
C4"Melee attacks"Cr change if you tilt the C4"Lever"Cr or C4"Left Stick"Cr while
pressing the C4"Melee button"Cr.
TUTO_CAPTION_L_9_4:
C4"Melee attacks"Cr change if you tilt the C4"Lever"Cr or C4"Left Stick"Cr while
pressing the C4"Y button"Cr.
TUTO_CAPTION_10_1: Press the C4"Melee button"Cr and C4"Jump button"Cr together to perform a C4"Special Melee"Cr.
TUTO_CAPTION_L_10_1: Press the C4"Y button"Cr and C4"A button"Cr together to perform a C4"Special Melee"Cr.

Input a Boost Dash during a Melee attack to perform
a C4"Boost Dash Cancel"Cr.
TUTO_CAPTION_11_2:
Like C4"Melee actionCr -> C4Boost DashCr -> C4Melee action"Cr, inserting
Boost Dash Cancels lets you land more hits.
TUTO_CAPTION_11_3: Use Cancels to try out various combos.
TUTO_CAPTION_12_1:
Press the C4"Shoot button"Cr, C4"Melee button"Cr and C4"Jump button"Cr together
to activate C4"EX Burst"Cr.
TUTO_CAPTION_L_12_1: Press in the C4"Right Stick"Cr to activate C4"EX Burst"Cr.
TUTO_CAPTION_12_2:
You can activate C4"EX Burst"Cr when the C4"EX Gauge"Cr at the bottom is C4100% or moreCr.
The C4"EX Gauge"Cr fills when you deal damage, take damage, and so on.
TUTO_CAPTION_12_3: Fill the EX Gauge and activate EX Burst.
TUTO_CAPTION_13_1:
After activating C4"EX Burst"Cr, your unit is powered up until the C4"EX Gauge"Cr runs out.
C4"EX Burst"Cr can turn the tide of battle, so use it actively.
TUTO_CAPTION_L_13_1:
After activating C4"EX Burst"Cr, your unit is powered up until the C4"EX Gauge"Cr runs out.
C4"EX Burst"Cr can turn the tide of battle, so use it actively.
TUTO_CAPTION_13_2:
For beginners we recommend C4"Shooting Burst"Cr.
While C4"Shooting Burst"Cr is active, you C4"can rapid-fire shooting attacks"Cr.
TUTO_CAPTION_14_1:
During C4"EX Burst"Cr, press the C4"Shoot button"Cr, C4"Melee button"Cr and C4"Jump button"Cr
together to perform a C4"Burst Attack"Cr.
TUTO_CAPTION_L_14_1:
During C4"EX Burst"Cr, press in the C4"Right Stick"Cr
to perform a C4"Burst Attack"Cr.
TUTO_CAPTION_14_2:
A C4"Burst Attack"Cr can only be used once per C4"EX Burst"Cr,
but it is a powerful action.
TUTO_CAPTION_14_3: Activate EX Burst and land a Burst Attack on the enemy.
TUTO_CAPTION_15_1:
Quickly input C4"DownCr -> C4Up"Cr on the C4"Lever"Cr or C4"Left Stick"Cr to activate
C4"Guard"Cr.
TUTO_CAPTION_15_2: C4"Guard"Cr is a C4"defensive action"Cr that blocks attacks coming from the front.
TUTO_CAPTION_15_3:
Keep holding the C4"Lever"Cr up to stay in C4"Guard"Cr, but Guard ends if you
tilt the lever another way or use up the C4"Boost Gauge"Cr.
TUTO_CAPTION_L_15_3:
Keep holding the C4"RB button"Cr to stay in C4"Guard"Cr,
but Guard ends if you use up the C4"Boost Gauge"Cr.
TUTO_CAPTION_15_4: Block an enemy attack with Guard.

to perform a C4"Step"Cr.

TUTO_CAPTION_16_3: Dodge an attack with a Step.
TUTO_CAPTION_17_1: The game screen shown now is the basic battle screen.
TUTO_CAPTION_17_2: The blue and red gauges at the top left are the C4"Force Gauges"Cr.
TUTO_CAPTION_17_3:
The C4"blue Force Gauge"Cr is your team's,
and the C4"red Force Gauge"Cr is the enemy team's.
TUTO_CAPTION_17_4:
A C4"Force Gauge"Cr drops when a unit is shot down.
To shoot down a unit, you must reduce its C4"Durability"Cr to 0.
TUTO_CAPTION_17_5:
Your C4"Durability"Cr is shown as a number at the bottom left,
and the enemy's C4"Durability"Cr as a red gauge.
TUTO_CAPTION_17_6:
You re-sortie automatically while your C4"Force Gauge"Cr remains.
The team that first reduces the enemy C4"Force Gauge"Cr to 0 wins.
TUTO_CAPTION_17_7: Defeat enemies to reduce the enemy team's Force Gauge.
TUTO_CAPTION_18_1:
When losing either you or your wingman would mean defeat,
C4"EX Over Limit"Cr becomes available.
TUTO_CAPTION_18_2:
C4"EX Over Limit"Cr activates while C4"STANDBY"Cr is shown when you
C4"hit an enemy"Cr or C4"take damage"Cr.
TUTO_CAPTION_18_3:
During C4"EX Over Limit"Cr, your unit is powered up and
landing attacks restores your Durability.
TUTO_CAPTION_18_4: Activate C4"EX Over Limit"Cr and attack the enemy.
TUTO_CAPTION_19_1: Activating C4"EX Over Limit"Cr deploys a C4"Barrier"Cr that blocks enemy attacks.
TUTO_CAPTION_19_2: While the C4"Barrier"Cr is up, it blocks all enemy attacks up to a set amount.
TUTO_CAPTION_19_3: Did you see the enemy's attacks bounce off the C4"Barrier"Cr?
TUTO_CAPTION_19_4:
C4"EX Over Limit"Cr also allows forceful attacks using the C4"Barrier"Cr.
When it activates, aim for a comeback and attack aggressively.
TUTO_CAPTION_L_20_1:
While holding the C4"RT button"Cr, the C4"EX Trigger"Cr is active.
While the C4"EX Trigger"Cr is active, each button's action changes.
TUTO_CAPTION_L_20_2:
With the C4"EX Trigger"Cr active, C4"B button"Cr does a C4"Sub Shot"Cr, C4"X button"Cr a C4"Special Shot"Cr,
and C4"Y button"Cr a C4"Special Melee"Cr.
TUTO_CAPTION_L_21_1:
Press the C4"B button"Cr to perform a C4"Support Attack"Cr.
A C4"Support Attack"Cr easily performs combos suited to your distance from the enemy.
TUTO_CAPTION_L_21_2:
When far from the enemy it performs C4"rapid-fire shots"Cr; when close,
the C4"Lock-On Marker"Cr changes and you can perform a C4"Melee combo"Cr.
TUTO_CAPTION_L_21_3: Use the C4"Support Attack"Cr to combo the enemy.
TUTO_CAPTION_22_1:
Units land after finishing a C4"Jump"Cr or C4"Boost Dash"Cr.
Units always stop moving on landing, making them easier to hit.
TUTO_CAPTION_22_2: Aim for the enemy's C4"landing"Cr opening and hit it with a shot.
TUTO_CAPTION_23_1:
Hitting an enemy with this unit's C4"Shoot"Cr makes it C4"stagger"Cr.
Like landing, a C4"stagger"Cr stops the enemy, giving a chance to follow up.
TUTO_CAPTION_23_2:
This enemy will C4"Guard"Cr right after staggering. Use C4"Shoot"Cr to make
the enemy C4"stagger"Cr, then follow up before it can C4"Guard"Cr.
TUTO_CAPTION_24_1:
Precisely targeting an enemy's C4"landing"Cr or C4"stagger"Cr with combos
lets you deal heavy damage.
TUTO_CAPTION_24_2:
Use C4"Shoot"Cr and C4"Melee"Cr to exploit the enemy's openings
and knock it down with combos.

PRC_RESULT_ONEPT_1:
Check your Practice mode record on the linked site.
Aim for an even better record!
PRC_RESULT_ONEPT_2:
Once the EX gauge passes 100%, you can use EX Burst.
Your unit is powered up during EX Burst. Use it to attack,
to escape, or at the crucial moment!
PRC_RESULT_ONEPT_3:
EX Burst gives you the edge on its own, but using it together
with your wingman extends the EX Burst duration.
Outplay the enemy with well-timed teamwork.
PRC_RESULT_ONEPT_4:
This game has a mechanic called Cost Over.
If defeated when the team gauge is under twice your cost,
you will sortie again with reduced durability.
PRC_RESULT_ONEPT_5:
The basic ranged attack is the 3-hit main shot combo:
repeat main shot and boost dash three times.
It varies by unit, but this is the first move to learn.
PRC_RESULT_ONEPT_6:
The basic Melee combo is two Melee attacks, then a step input,
followed by three more Melee attacks.
Melee attacks vary greatly by unit. Practice with each one.
PRC_RESULT_ONEPT_7:
F Burst powers up Melee!
Melee improves, and you can cancel shooting attacks
into Melee attacks. Go all out with your Melee!
PRC_RESULT_ONEPT_8:
S Burst powers up shooting!
Its key feature is that you can cancel shooting attacks into
shooting attacks. Fire away like crazy!
PRC_RESULT_ONEPT_9:
E Burst specializes in defense!
With 100% EX gauge you can use EX Burst even when hit.
When you can't afford to be shot down, use it without hesitation.
PRC_RESULT_ONEPT_10:
When your team gauge can take only one more loss and
both of your team's units are on the stage,
EX Over Limit goes on standby.
PRC_RESULT_ONEPT_11:
While EX Over Limit is on standby,
hitting an enemy or getting hit by one
activates EX Over Limit.
PRC_RESULT_ONEPT_12:
The basic ways to dodge are boost dash and step.
Enemy in front: go left/right. Enemy to your side:
boost dash or step forward or back.
PRC_RESULT_ONEPT_13:
If controls feel hard, try the gamepad Light Type first!
With Support Attack, even if you're new to the controls,
you can move your unit and fight aggressively.
PRC_RESULT_ONEPT_14:
Registering with VS. Mobile unlocks many features, but the first
thing to set up is your Player Navi! Pick the one you like from a
wide variety of characters.
PRC_RESULT_ONEPT_15:
When teamed with another player, use the comms button to send
messages. Sending "Nice to meet you" at the start and "Thanks"
at the end is good manners.
PRC_RESULT_ONEPT_16:
In CPU battles, your wingman may be a CPU unit.
A CPU wingman doesn't reduce the team gauge when defeated,
but its number of re-sorties is limited by cost.
PRC_RESULT_ONEPT_17:
Units have all kinds of attacks. Some come out when you input
main shot again after a main shot, and some only when you input
Melee after a Special Melee.
PRC_RESULT_ONEPT_18:
Overusing the Boost gauge causes an overheat.
If you keep acting while overheated,
you won't be able to act at all for a while.
PRC_RESULT_ONEPT_19:
Shooting attacks vary: some hit falling targets easily,
some hit targets moving sideways, some knock down in one
hit, and more. Use the right attack for the situation.
PRC_RESULT_ONEPT_20:
Not sure how to dodge? Input lever back then forward to guard!
Holding out until your ally comes to help is an option.
You can also buy time by rising to get above the enemy.
